ponce-city-market-tower.json.asset: ponce-city-market-tower.json: the Ponce City Market tower top (brick belvedere, round-headed windows, truncated hipped copper roof, raised cap, gold finial), baked to one vertex-colored template
ponce-city-market-tower.json.tool: img2threejs v2.0.0 (commit a669e9a97cea4452b1c2310c5cca6aa0f6657c1f, Apache-2.0), run in Claude Code; baked by scripts/bake-landmark.mjs
ponce-city-market-tower.json.method: Reconstruction in code from one reference image: a sculpt spec (landmarks/ponce-city-market/object-sculpt-spec.json, written by build_spec.py), the generated Three.js factory, and post_generate.py. No mesh extraction and no photo texture: flat colors only.

reference.title: Ponce City Market from Historic Fourth Ward Park
reference.author: Tyler Lahti
reference.use: Visual reference for shapes and colors only; no pixels of the photo are in the game asset.

ponce-city-market-tower.json.prompt: None. The spec and the scripts are the full recipe.
ponce-city-market-tower.json.review: img2threejs passes blockout, structural, and form passed; the material pass stopped at request-input on a Tier 1 limit (5 color clusters for 6 part colors). The Tier 1 silhouette IoU in these passes was 1.0 only because neither mask isolated the subject; the turntable gate and the visual reviews are the real evidence. See docs/decisions.md.
